name: print-social-black-social-media-intro-and-red-profile-card-over-fog-photo
title: Social Media Intro and Profile Card over Red Fog
whatItIs: A split board: a black panel with a 'Social Media' label, red platform icon tiles and a large statement about consistent social content, and a red-fogged night photo of figures overlaid with a white profile card whose cover is a red striped chart.
whatItMeans: The red fog photo carries the brand colour, and the profile card shows how the identity appears in a feed.
techniques: Profile card overlaid on a photo
Two equal panels black and photo

vocabulary.definition: A card showing an account's avatar, name and stats.
Logos of social networks used as tiles.
A photo lit in the brand colour.
